tasks.label: Android: Build Debug APK
tasks.command: source "$HOME/.zshrc" && npm run cap:sync && cd android && ./gradlew :app:assembleDebug --console=plain

tasks.label: Android: Install and Launch on USB Device
tasks.command: source "$HOME/.zshrc" && adb -d install -r "${workspaceFolder}/android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk" && adb -d shell monkey -p com.marinecircle.portdistance 1

tasks.label: Android: Build, Install, and Launch (USB)
dependsOn: Android: Install and Launch on USB Device
